_why: The vectors behind the vendor-prefix rules added 2026-08-31 for ROW-108, in
the tree so they can be re-run rather than believed. Written under the rule
adopted 2026-08-18: if a commit message states a measurement, the set it was
measured against must be in the tree.
Read by BOTH engines from this one file, on purpose. web/tools/parity.mjs
compares regex SOURCE and flags, never behaviour, so two engines can hold
byte-identical patterns and still disagree on a string; that is ROW-109 and
set of strings through both is the only form of this check that can see it.
Adding a vector here tests both sides or neither.
These live in tools/fixtures/ because that is the one path .gitleaks.toml
allowlists for deliberately fake credentials. Do not move them into a file
that holds real code, and do not widen the allowlist to follow them.
Every string below is synthetic. The Notion token is the scripted-owner

must_fire._note: Each must produce E_SECRET_FOUND in preflight.py AND at the endpoint. A miss here publishes a live credential.
